facts.fact: The current partial-withdrawal rules are in para 46 of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 (G.S.R. 525(E), Gazette dated 29 June 2026), made under the Code on Social Security, 2020, which superseded the EPF Scheme, 1952
facts.quote: G.S.R. 525(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 15 of the Code on Social Security (36 of 2020) and in supersession of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952

facts.fact: The e-Gazette copy of the EPF Scheme, 2026 (CG-DL-E-01072026-273957) was digitally signed and uploaded on 01 July 2026
facts.quote: Digitally signed by SARVESH KUMAR KUMAR SRIVASTAVA SRIVASTAVA Date: 2026.07.01 00:40:08

facts.fact: The EPF Scheme, 2026 came into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
facts.quote: It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

facts.fact: The CBT decided on 13 Oct 2025 to merge 13 partial-withdrawal provisions into a single rule (essential needs, housing, special circumstances)
facts.quote: CBT decided to simplify the partial withdrawal provisions of EPF Scheme by merging 13 complex provisions into a single, streamlined rule categorized into three types namely, Essential Needs (illness, education, marriage), Housing Needs and Special Circumstances.

facts.fact: Partial withdrawal is applied for on the designated portal and must be at least Rs 1,000
facts.quote: The Commissioner may, on an application from a member on the designated portal sanction from the amount standing to the credit of the member in the Fund, a partial withdrawal not less than rupees one thousand

facts.fact: A Minimum Balance of 25% of total contributions (employee and employer share with interest) must always stay in the account
facts.quote: “minimum balance” means an amount equivalent to twenty-five per cent of the aggregate of the total contributions made to the Fund to the credit of the member (inclusive of both the employee’s and the employer’s share and interest thereon)

facts.fact: The Eligible Member Balance is the PF balance minus the Minimum Balance
facts.quote: “Eligible Member Balance” means the amount standing to the credit of the member in the Fund after deducting the Minimum Balance required to be maintained.

facts.fact: Illness of self or family: up to 100% of the Eligible Member Balance after 12 months' total membership (no count limit stated)
facts.quote: in case of illness of self and family members, an amount up to one hundred per cent of the Eligible Member Balance, after completion of twelve months’ total membership of the Fund;

facts.fact: Education of self or family: up to 100% of the Eligible Member Balance after 12 months' membership, at most 10 times during membership
facts.quote: for the education of self and family members, an amount up to one hundred per cent of the Eligible Member Balance, after completion of twelve months’ total membership of the Fund and partial withdrawal on this account shall not exceed ten times during the membership;

facts.fact: Marriage of self or family: up to 100% of the Eligible Member Balance after 12 months' membership, at most 5 times during membership
facts.quote: for the marriage of self and family members an amount up to one hundred per cent of the Eligible Member Balance, after completion of twelve months’ total membership of the Fund and partial withdrawal on this account shall not exceed five times during the membership of the Fund.

facts.fact: Housing (purchase, site, construction, home-loan repayment, additions/renovation): up to 100% of the Eligible Member Balance after 12 months' membership, at most 5 times during membership
facts.quote: Provided that the amount of such withdrawal shall not exceed one hundred per cent of the Eligible Member Balance after completion of twelve months of total membership in the Fund and partial withdrawal on this account shall not exceed five times during the membership.

facts.fact: Special circumstances: up to 100% of the Eligible Member Balance after 12 months' membership, at most 2 times in a financial year
facts.quote: A member may, in special circumstances be allowed partial withdrawal from the Fund, up to one hundred per cent of the Eligible Member Balance after completion of twelve months of total membership of the Fund and partial withdrawals from this account shall not exceed two times in a financial year.

facts.fact: Under special circumstances no reason has to be given (CBT decision)
facts.quote: Now, the member can apply without assigning any reasons under this category.

facts.fact: A member who leaves employment before completing 12 months' membership can still withdraw, up to the Eligible Member Balance
facts.quote: A member exiting employment before completing twelve months membership shall be eligible to avail the partial withdrawal under this paragraph, subject to the condition that the amount of such withdrawal shall not exceed the Eligible Member Balance on the date of such withdrawal.

facts.fact: The number of withdrawals is counted afresh from the date the 2026 Scheme began
facts.quote: The permissible number of times for availing partial withdrawal under sub-paragraphs (2), (3) and (4) shall be calculated afresh in respect of each member on and from the date of commencement of this Scheme.

facts.fact: Full settlement is separate (para 49), e.g. on retirement after age 55, permanent incapacity, emigration, retrenchment or VRS
facts.quote: A member may withdraw the full amount standing to his credit in the Fund — (i) on retirement from service after attaining of the age of fifty-five years

facts.fact: When unemployed, 75% of the PF balance can be withdrawn at once and the remaining 25% after one year
facts.quote: In case of unemployment, 75% PF balance ( that includes employer and employee contribution and interest earned) can be withdrawn immediately. Remaining 25% can also be withdrawn after one year.

facts.fact: In practice about 75% of the eligible PF amount (including the employer share) can be withdrawn
facts.quote: As a result, 75% of the eligible amount that can now be withdrawn will be much higher than the amount he/she could withdraw under the previous provisions.

facts.fact: Full settlement (para 49) is also allowed on retirement due to permanent and total incapacity for work
facts.quote: on retirement on account of permanent and total incapacity for work due to bodily or mental infirmity duly certified by the medical officer of the establishment

facts.fact: Full settlement (para 49) is also allowed before emigration, on retrenchment, and on voluntary retirement (VRS)
facts.quote: immediately before migration from India for permanent settlement abroad or for taking employment abroad; (iv) on termination of service in the case of mass or individual retrenchment; (v) on termination of service under a voluntary scheme of retirement

facts.fact: The old 1952-Scheme (para 68) withdrawal rules, which allowed only the employee share with interest (50-100%), are no longer current
facts.quote: Prior to the simplification of norms, the member was allowed to withdraw only the employee contribution and interest ranging from 50-100%.

summary: All values confirmed against EPF Scheme, 2026 para 46/49 (G.S.R. 525(E)) and PIB 13/15 Oct 2025; no change.
